_meta.note: Structured counts are the SOURCE OF TRUTH for enumeration numbers. Prose renders as explicit 'N of M' generated/checked from this file - no bare ratios anywhere (kills the 56/37 vs 37/56 ambiguity). Internal coherence (total = det + nondet; fraction fields consistent) is guarded by test_consistency; values are guarded against recomputation by test_regression.
_meta.nondeterministic_definition: PINNED (2026-07-05, per audit caveat): 'nondeterministic' means SOME effect among E0, E1, F, G is not single-valued (equivalently: F or G not single-valued - same count). Under the narrower 'F alone not single-valued' reading the n=2 free count would be 25, not 37. All counts in this file use the pinned any-effect reading.
_meta.predicate_warning: w1/w2 (converse-containment, printed by ledger_A_round2.py) are DIFFERENT predicates from RET-existence/RET-exclusivity (Delta-inclusions, recomputed in test_regression). Do not conflate.
_meta.artifact_class: values are canonical data, regression-guarded; any RENDERING of them is Class D and never presentable as a Class-A result (DECISION-CLASSES.md)
